blind_reason: Proposes STARM, a star topology and rejection oversampler combining ideas of Polynom-fit-SMOTE, LEE and SMOTE; compared with 77 oversamplers on 91 datasets.
Proposes ASMOBD, density-based adaptive synthesis per minority sample with smoothing, combined with cost-sensitive SVM; nine UCI datasets.
Proposes PAIO, position-aware interpolation for inland, borderline and trapped minority samples, plus GIC for categorical attributes; real datasets.
New oversampler training a VAE to generate minority samples for defect prediction; ten PROMISE sets, compared with ROS, SMOTE, Borderline-SMOTE and ADASYN.
Designs a neural network that generates new minority ECG samples in a high-dimensional feature space, plus a residual attention classifier; compared with imbalance methods on MIMIC-IV.
Proposes RBM-SMOTE: a restricted Boltzmann machine transforms SMOTE examples toward the true distribution; experiment on credit scoring data.
Introduces KNN-SMOTE, an enhancement of Borderline-SMOTE; evaluated on five UCI imbalanced sets with F-score, G-mean, AUC. DOCTYPE: chapter
Proposes USWAVG-BS: noise identification in HVDM space, undersampling or relabeling, then weighted generation similar to Safe-level-SMOTE; 10 datasets, 14 competitors.
Classifier-feedback-guided sampling from a text-to-image generative model to add useful synthetic images for underrepresented classes; ImageNet-LT, Places-LT, NICO++.
Proposes LSDMLO, a multi-label oversampler using label-specific distances for seed and neighbor selection; compared with multi-label sampling methods under several classifiers.
Proposes SOA: outlier detection picks representative minority seeds before SMOTE or ADASYN generation; tested on four synthetic and four real datasets.
Designs CycleGAN generators and discriminators to synthesize minority fraud transactions; synthetic plus real data improve a fraud detection model.
Generates minority data by single-point crossover, then Jellyfish Search selects an optimal subset; 18 datasets against known oversamplers.
Intrusion detection system with mixture model that also claims a novel cluster-based oversampling technique for minority attacks; three public datasets. Oversampler details not given.
Proposes SA-GAN, a supervised autoencoder GAN to oversample minority lung ultrasound classes; tested on 5500 images with accuracy gain over classic augmentation.
Proposes elementary cellular automata rules to generate synthetic minority points; reports accuracy on datasets against classical techniques.
Devises weighted minority oversampling (WMO) with a new synthesis strategy, plus enhanced auto-encoder features; 25 benchmark imbalanced sets and an engineering dataset.
Ensemble with a novel resampling strategy raising the weight of hard samples, 44 KEEL sets; abstract does not say whether it oversamples, duplicates or creates synthetic examples.
Proposes SMOTE-Cov, using the covariance matrix instead of KNN, two variants; validated with C4.5 and Friedman/Holm tests. DOCTYPE: chapter
Proposes MOSGNN, built on oversampled minority graphs at subgraph, graph and pairwise scales; 16 datasets. Unclear whether new examples are synthetic or the focus is representation learning.
Proposes an improved SMOTE with distribution-based resampling inside a selective ensemble for ECG heartbeats; tested on MIT-BIH.
Proposes COBRA, synthesizing counterfactual variants of flows into rare attack classes to rebalance training; evaluated on NSL-KDD and CICIDS17 with DNNs.
Proposes MAOTE, an adaptive evolutionary-search oversampler for multi-class fault data embedded in multi-layer LSSVM; bearing datasets, ten augmentation baselines.
Proposes SUPERAUG, adaptive multi-noise injection combined with SMOTE for the minority class, as a key contribution; evaluated on Egyptian and NHANES datasets.
Framework includes its own physics-inspired conditional latent diffusion model to synthesize rare photovoltaic defect samples for classification; evaluated on public and industrial datasets.
Proposes adversarial augmentation: generator of synthetic high-risk samples with a discriminator and an auxiliary risk discriminator; three credit datasets.
Proposes a bias-correction procedure for training on synthetic oversampled data such as SMOTE, with bounds and real data analyses; changes how oversampling is used, no generator of its own.
Proposes KB-SMOTE synthesizing between K-means++ cluster centers and borderline minority points; tested on several imbalanced datasets.
Proposes iBRF, a novel hybrid sampling step inside each bootstrap of a random forest; 44 datasets, 14 sampling baselines. Synthetic generation implied, not explicit.
Ergonomic risk framework that includes its own extended oversampler KD-SMOTE considering relevant activities, plus a hybrid network; evaluated on assembly process data.
Proposes AP-iB-SMOTE: improved affinity propagation clustering with Gini impurity plus an improved Borderline-SMOTE with separate formulas for safe and risky samples; 27 datasets.
Introduces QI-SMOTE, a quantum-inspired SMOTE generating synthetic minority instances; validated on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV against Borderline-SMOTE, ADASYN and others.
Proposes QAGS: CVAE boundary sample mining, WGAN-GP expansion and an ensemble quality filter for fraud minority samples; evaluated on a real dataset.
Proposes BSCGAN, a structured conditional GAN oversampling minority images in a VAE latent space; evaluated on Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, BreakHis and WAFER.
Contribution is transaction graph construction for fraud detection; existing graph SMOTE integrated, with edges for synthetic nodes set by the same similarity rule. Borderline.
Proposes ABEX-RAT: LLM abstract-then-expand generation of synthetic reports to balance classes, plus random adversarial training; OSHA dataset, Macro-F1 reported.

Autoencoder-based augmentation that adversarially perturbs latent vectors, framed for imbalanced time series in title and abstract; abstract does not state explicitly that only minority classes are augmented.
Proposes A-RDBOTE: noise removal, minority clustering, representative anchor selection and generation around anchors for credit scoring; beats eight oversamplers.
Proposes Region-SMOTE with a vote rule splitting minority into safe, intermediate, dangerous samples; four datasets, F-value and G-mean.
Presents DySMOTE (SMOTE oversampling plus dynamic per-epoch sample selection in MLP training) as its approach; tested on EEG data of eight subjects. DySMOTE may be a prior method.
Develops own Three-way Oversampling (3WOS) to generate minority fault-text vectors within a Bayesian network diagnosis pipeline; validated on railway cases.
Enhances ADASYN with decision-boundary proximity and realistic distribution constraints as part of its Ponzi contract detection method; evaluated on XBlock dataset.
Proposes a hybrid framework that removes noisy majority examples before synthetic minority generation; G-mean gains for eight classifiers on eleven datasets.
Language-model oversampling with GPT-3 prompts built from DBpedia to create examples for under-represented NER entity classes; evaluated on benchmark NER sets. Token-level classification task.
Proposes MC-NRO, a multiclass neighborhood repartition oversampler using mutual class potential with cleaning for label noise; outperforms other oversamplers.
Modifies Safe-Level SMOTE neighbor function with Manhattan distance for high-dimensional hyperspectral data, with CNN bagging at differentiated sampling rates; compared with other methods.
Proposes oversampling that produces non-dominated synthetic examples under two criteria plus a specialized undersampling step; compared with leading balancing methods using GEP.
Proposes a parametric method estimating minority class statistics from nearby classes as an alternative to convex-combination oversampling; synthetic and real benchmarks.
Proposes GASMOTE: a genetic algorithm sets per-sample sampling rates for SMOTE; tested on 10 imbalanced datasets and rockburst data.
Generates molecular conformations as new examples to balance toxicity classes; tested on Tox21 with balanced accuracy gains.
Proposes SMOTENN, a MapReduce resampler doing oversampling and intelligent undersampling in one pass; compared with other resampling techniques on small to large datasets.
Proposes an embedding-space resampling technique generating synthetic minority samples near decision boundaries; tested on a 21-class bone marrow cytology dataset.
Proposes Outlier-SMOTE, allocating more synthesis to points far from others; tested on five benchmark sets and a COVID-19 dataset.
Proposes GAN-based generation with meta information for minority data in imbalanced big data, to limit overfitting; experiments reported, details thin.
Proposes HSDP: region partition, noise minority removal, boundary seeds, weighted in-cluster synthetic generation; eight datasets.
Proposes chaoticGAN to oversample minority class, plus hybrid with OCSVM undersampling; evaluated on churn, fraud and default datasets.
Proposes DBOKS: DBO-stabilized K-means regions constrain SMOTE interpolation, presented as the data-level method and evaluated on carbonate lithology well logs.
Presents SB-GAN and SB-VAE, generators that screen borderline and noisy samples before training; four tabular datasets, eight oversampling baselines.
Proposes hybrid sampling: SMOTE with star topology for the minority plus distribution-based removal of majority instances; tested on biometric data.
Proposes FLO: focal-loss feature selection then a focal-loss-based oversampler generating minority instances; tested on high-dimensional biomedical datasets.
Proposes generating synthetic cyber-physical attack samples by merging frequent itemset mining with a generative model, to address class imbalance; quality evaluated with three classifiers.
Presents Image-based SMOTified-GAN, a SMOTE plus GAN oversampler for tuberculosis chest X-rays; compared with other oversampling techniques using GoogleNet.
Intrusion detection framework whose own LLM-guided GAN generates new attack-class patterns, alongside standard SMOTE; ablation on three IDS sets. Generator is one part of a larger framework.
Proposes FEM-constrained improved elliptical SMOTE with KL-divergence indicator for bolt looseness signals; validated on a monitoring platform.
Proposes diversity-based multi-cluster oversampling using Mahalanobis distance and cluster density for defect prediction; tested with five learners.
Proposes FG-SMOTE, a fuzzy-based Gaussian SMOTE using a fuzzy Levenshtein distance; evaluated with a deep belief network classifier.
Analyzes the DeepSMOTE penalty term and proposes a refined version of it; validated on MNIST, FMNIST, CIFAR-10, SVHN. Mostly analysis, the refinement is small.
Claims a custom oversampling strategy for liver-injury prediction as its contribution and reports results; abstract does not say how examples are generated or whether synthetic.
Proposes an oversampling strategy combining GPT-2 text generation with SMOTE for imbalanced MBTI classes, alongside a new CNN; accuracy and F1 reported.
Proposes HNaNSMOTE, parameter-free hybrid natural neighbor rule for SMOTE; 32 datasets, three classifiers.
Enhances Active SMOTE with an uncertainty-aware module that selects ambiguous minority seeds for kNN interpolation; tested on ECG and gas sensor datasets.
Proposes genetic-algorithm procedures that set sampling ratios for existing over-, under- and hybrid samplers, changing how they are applied; 14 datasets. No new generator itself.
Fuel cell fault diagnosis framework with its own dual attention Wasserstein GAN for minority fault synthesis, combined with SMOTE-Tomek; tested under extreme imbalance.
Proposes transformer-based conditional WGAN to synthesize fault samples plus reinforcement learning to select good synthetic ones; improves AHU fault classification.
Improves SMOTE and combines it with K-means for IPTV complaint prediction; compared against Borderline-SMOTE with Naive Bayes.
Proposes AE-OM: autoencoder trained on majority manifold reconstructs new minority samples; compared with 15 imbalance methods.
Proposes VAE-WGAN-GP generator for scarce water quality classes; compensation experiments raise multi-class accuracy.
Application paper on deception-risk text that introduces its own semantic-constrained oversampling for the minority class alongside a wolf search optimizer; evaluated on several benchmarks.
Proposes Graph-DAO, generating synthetic minority nodes before the GNN with sum-product network distribution alignment; tested on four real graph datasets.
Proposes WASSKIL, a MAHAKIL-based oversampler using Wasserstein distance for partitioning; evaluated on PHM 2015 industrial plant data.
Proposes a modified GAN producing synthetic minority-class medical images; tested on endoscopic and pathological datasets. English title comes first, the bracketed part is an Arabic secondary title.
Proposes improved SMOTEBagging: improved SMOTE with selective ensemble and bagging; tested on four UCI sets and protein interaction data.
Proposes dynamic SMOTE-based rotation forest: per-tree balancing mixing resampled and SMOTE-generated minority instances at a changing rate; tested on three hyperspectral datasets.
Proposes IECA: entropy-based cleaning of overlap by undersampling plus interpolation oversampling near the boundary; tested on three ARB datasets with five classifiers.
Proposes SI-SMOTE, a sample-information based SMOTE using Mahalanobis distance, within a semi-supervised tri-training ensemble; tested on bearing and wheel fault datasets.
Proposes CCR-GSVM: majority noise filtering via SVM and GSVM-RU, then CCR-based boundary synthetic generation; 12 datasets.
Proposes a bag-level oversampling approach for imbalanced multiple instance learning, tested on nine benchmarks; abstract does not say whether the new bags are synthetic.
Proposes K-means plus improved Wasserstein GAN to generate fault samples for aero-engine diagnosis; compared with SMOTE.
Proposes SSAO: GMM clustering of each minority class and generation inside enclosing spheres for multi-class data; 15 datasets, 11 competitors. I1-new-variant also fits.
Integrates a K* entropy distance into SMOTE and CNN plus Tomek links, and introduces a SMOTE plus SMaRT combination; F-score robustness on yield data.
Proposes EC-EBO: constrained clustering, entropy-balanced generation regions, hill-climbing placement, entropy-weighted allocation; 60 datasets.
Claims an enhanced SMOTE with reverse kNN noise removal and density-based allocation; compared with SMOTE. Resembles published SMOTE-RkNN, novelty should be checked.
Proposes CIB boosting that assigns a credibility factor to each synthetic sample and reweights accordingly; tested on 20 NASA and PROMISE defect sets.
Proposes LAMO: borderline seeds, local distribution, GMM-based generation with adaptive coefficients; simulated and real datasets.
Proposes RRBoost: a new synthetic generator R-ROSE integrated into boosting; compared with other ensembles on 24 real imbalanced datasets.
Proposes synthetic sample generation in language-model embedding space to upsample minority classes; tested on text benchmarks. May only apply existing oversamplers to embeddings.
Designs a dynamic GAN to generate minority samples, combined with a self-adaptive multilayer ELM; four biomedical datasets, compared with SMOTE-ELM and others.
Proposes a SMOTE-based traffic augmentation algorithm with validation functions (KS test, ROC AUC) that tune its hyperparameters; CICIDS2017 with random forest.
Generates fake minority text vectors by adding random noise to Paragraph Vector embeddings of malicious macros; detection rate improves in experiments.
Proposes Expansive Over-Sampling: convex combinations of minority samples and nearest adversaries in CNN embedding space within a three-phase training framework; compared with resampling baselines.
Proposes Re-SSS: safe sample screening to select majority samples plus a weighted SMOTE generating informative minority samples; experiments reported.
Novel resampling that translates majority samples into minority samples via a translation loss, within a deep ECG model; tested on MIT-BIH.
Proposes ML-ESB, a modified SMOTEBagging with heterogeneous base classifiers; six benchmark sets against SMOTEBagging and SMOTEBoost. Resampling step itself appears unchanged.
Proposes Data-shaping SMOTE via manifold reconstruction and energy minimization; support is mostly theoretical with only a vague claim of F1, G-Mean and AUC gains, no datasets named. Preprint.
Proposes SB-GAN, a conditional GAN with adaptive class balancing scaled to the smallest class for hyperspectral minority classes; tested on three public scenes.

Proposes an original model that synthesizes samples in critical areas of the class distribution, tested on Iris and wine sets; abstract is English plus Ukrainian, so full-text language needs checking.
Matrix factorization based generator of synthetic positive samples in a subspace, with cost-driven sample counts and distance filtering; tested on 10 microbial sets.
Proposes GAN over BERT embeddings to generate synthetic spam (minority) messages; initial results show better detection.
Proposes alpha-Distance Borderline-ADASYN-SMOTE combining optimized Borderline-SMOTE and ADASYN with neighbor distance; applied to ADNI data with DenseNet.
Proposes data partition hybrid sampling with a boundary weighted BMW-SMOTE plus dynamic ensemble model selection; outperforms typical imbalance methods.
Method pairs hierarchical-clustering-guided oversampling of minority sub-clusters with parallel MapReduce SVM; tested with G-mean. Whether new samples are synthetic is not stated.
Proposes CSMOTE, a variational latent-space generator of minority time series from private and common representations; evaluated on five benchmark datasets.
Proposes RIC-SMOTE, dividing minority samples into regions and allocating synthesis by regional information contribution; experiments reported.
Proposes MLNaNBDOS, a multi-label natural-neighbor boundary oversampler with adaptive oversampling factor and controlled generation; three load deviation datasets, nine baselines.
Density-weighted cGAN with noise removal and boundary/safe region split for stroke data; beats SMOTE, ADASYN, Borderline-SMOTE.

Introduces conformational oversampling: extra molecule conformations generated to balance the toxic minority class; Tox21 classification. Authors say samples are not artificial, so synthetic status is debatable.
Introduces PFS-SMOTE, generating fault samples in a physics-guided Siamese feature space; two bearing datasets.
Proposes DEC-SVM: differential evolution mutation/crossover oversampling plus clustering-based cleaning; ten UCI datasets.
Introduces GM4OS, evolving seed selection (GA) and a synthetic generation function (GP); ten datasets against five oversamplers.
Proposes TSDAS-SMOTE, improved Borderline-SMOTE with two-step filtering and adaptive seed selection; compared with six oversamplers on wind turbine bolt data.
Proposes an artificial immune network combined with an improved SMOTE to generate synthetic samples, inside a robust feature selection method; six medical datasets.
Proposes Informative Sample Selection, choosing useful minority seeds for synthetic generation; 22 datasets, compared with SMOTE, Borderline-SMOTE, ADASYN and others.
Proposes improved VAE-CGAN oversampler with density-peak clustering noise filter and Wasserstein loss; compared with 5 oversamplers on 9 UCI/KEEL sets plus a circuit dataset.
Proposes INOS for time series: covariance structure preserving Gaussian oversampling combined with interpolation-based oversampling; tested on seven public datasets with SVM.
Proposes ClusIM: K-means cluster switching to form subsets, SMOTE per subset by imbalance ratio, SVM vote; seven datasets.
Changes how SMOTE, B-SMOTE and ADASYN are applied: resampling per subtree on its feature subset inside random forest (PSRF, PBSRF, PADRF); 10 KEEL sets.
Proposes an inception-based GAN to synthesize heart sound samples for underrepresented classes; classifiers compared with and without GAN on PhysioNet.
Proposes Anch-SCGAN, an anchor-based conditional GAN with contrastive loss for tabular oversampling; tested on 16 real imbalanced datasets.
Proposes AxelSMOTE, agent-based oversampling with trait grouping, similarity-based exchange and Beta blending; tested on eight imbalanced datasets.
Proposes OCH-SMOTE: one-vs-one decomposition with an enhanced CH-SMOTE for multiclass imbalance; evaluated on 18 multiclass sets.
Proposes LDAS: local density, a new cleaning of overlapping majority examples, and boundary and density weighted synthetic generation; KEEL experiments.
Proposes ALMCMO: estimates adaptive minority-space volumes around minority points and samples synthetic points from them; 23 datasets, six competitors.
Proposes VCOS, an oversampler that generates new samples guided by classifier performance; tested on several real imbalanced binary datasets.

Appears to propose a centroid-based oversampling algorithm with attribute selection and kNN, compared with traditional oversampling on agriculture sensor data; abstract wording is unclear about novelty.
Proposes GraphSGN, synthesizing minority nodes with feature mixing and class-balanced graph augmentation; tested on six benchmark graph datasets.
New algorithm combining oversampling with boosting, where each round's error guides the next sampling; experiments reported. Abstract does not state whether samples are synthetic.
Empirical defect prediction study on NASA MDP that also proposes SMOTE ASMO, an improvement of SMOTE; evaluation of the variant only implied.
Proposes ontology-based creation of extra minority text samples followed by random oversampling and feature selection; tested on Hamshahri Persian corpus.
Proposes LD-SMOTE: density-based allocation with new distance metric and triangular placement; compared with 16 resamplers on 19 datasets.
Proposes FRDOAC: affinity propagation, fuzzy representativeness difference as stopping metric, chromosome-inheritance generation of positive samples; tested on 16 benchmark datasets.
Proposes RareSimGAN to synthesize images of rare crop disease classes; rare-class recall of a ResNet50 classifier improves on real data.
Proposes AWGAN: density-based noise removal, boundary-aware weights and weighted GAN generation of minority instances; 21 datasets, eleven oversampling baselines.
Proposes own resampling algorithm for medical data: subgroup split by a key feature, LOF and Z-score noise removal, adaptive synthetic generation; tested on three datasets against SMOTE and ADASYN.
Proposes DTWSSE: SMOTE-style oversampling for time series with DTW distance and interpolation in a siamese autoencoder feature space; validated on several time series sets.
Application paper that proposes its own improved adaptive synthetic sampling algorithm for power system security assessment; tested on 39-bus and 118-bus systems.
Extends deep over-sampling framework with weak abstract labels to guide representation; abstract states no synthetic example generation. Could be include on full text. Preprint.
Customized diffusion model generates fault samples against imbalance; samples used unlabeled in self-supervised pretraining for HVAC fault classification.
Proposes ClustSyn: clustering plus Mahalanobis-distance synthetic minority generation; compared with boosting methods on 11 datasets.
Proposes SVDDWSMOTE: SVDD boundary cleaning plus density and boundary-distance weighted SMOTE; compared on several datasets.
Proposes Naive Bayes Sampling, generating new minority instances by bootstrapping per-feature values; tested on four UCI sets and a medical set. DOCTYPE: thesis
Proposes TAMS-DCSL: topology-aware minority sampling in safe-core regions plus dynamic cost-sensitive learning; tested on growth monitoring data and public benchmarks.
Proposes Eigen-Entropy metric and two EE-guided oversampling techniques for minority classes, tested on 10 public sets; abstract does not say whether samples are synthetic or selected.
Proposes Quantum-SMOTEV2, synthesizing minority samples by swap tests and quantum rotation around a centroid with angular outliers; evaluated on a telecom churn dataset.
Within a credit risk ensemble, proposes a new bagging-based oversampling of the minority class across parallel subsets; bank ledger data and five public datasets.
Proposes ITCGAN, a GAN with classifier and pretraining module generating minority traffic samples; ISCXVPN2016, beats five oversampling methods.
Proposes MTDOT, multi-level back-translation to create new minority (offensive) text samples for balancing; compared with SMOTE on HASOC21.
Rebalances defect datasets by creating additional defective samples with mutation operators; compared with five oversamplers on 27 PROMISE releases.
Proposes BO-SMOTE, generating minority samples iteratively by Bayesian optimization with interval targeting and sample selection; twenty datasets.
Besides a random forest sgRNA classifier, proposes a new method called CS-Smote for the imbalanced data; evaluated on five datasets. Mechanism not described.
Proposes WHSBoost: weighted SMOTE plus weighted undersampling inside boosting; tested on simulated, benchmark and credit scoring data.

Power oscillation recognition framework that introduces DeepSMOTE1D, oversampling in encoder-decoder feature space, and evaluates its effect; unclear whether it is the paper's own adaptation or existing DeepSMOTE.
Proposes physics-aware conditional VAE to augment imbalanced failure-mode classes; compared against established oversamplers with eight classifiers.

Proposes NDESO for multiclass data: noisy points displaced toward neighbors, then random oversampling; 20 real datasets, 14 baselines. Generation is duplication of adjusted points, so synthetic status is arguable.
Proposes a SMOTE variant combined with different error costs for SVM; compared with SMOTE, cost-based SVM and undersampling.
Novel deep learning based oversampler treating generation as a composition of learned decisions; experiments on real datasets against state-of-the-art oversamplers.
Proposes model-driven sampling that generates new points from an induced probabilistic graphical model; four medical datasets, two baseline samplers.
Proposes GBL-SMOTE generating at minority cluster borders; tested on artificial and public data. Korean journal, full text language should be checked.
Improved random forest with clustering-SMOTE embedded in the forest as part of the proposed method; tested on Canvas MOOC data.
Introduces a sliding oversampling method for imbalanced storm nowcasting classification alongside a spatiotemporal network; unclear whether samples are synthetic or shifted real windows.
Proposes SMOTE-ADC for signal modulation classification: SMOTE-based generation with a weighted eigenvalue distance matrix, plus evaluation of generated data; experiments reported.
Proposes RQSP-SMOTE: regular quadrilateral scoring with perturbation selects samples for multi-linear interpolation without kNN; compared with improved SMOTE variants across classifiers.
Hardware Trojan detection method in which Borderline-SMOTE samples are further optimized by a genetic algorithm, a named part of the contribution; evaluated with LightGBM.
Proposes Stochastic Sensitivity Oversampling, drawing Gaussian synthetic samples within Q-neighborhoods of minority points; experiments on several datasets.
Proposes Geometric SMOTE, placing synthetic samples in a hyper-spheroid region around minority instances; compared against SMOTE and baselines.
Proposes a varied-density safe-level SMOTE (VDB-SLSMOTE) combined with feature reduction for rotating machinery faults; experiment reported. Abstract does not fully confirm the variant is new.
Proposes WMCOA, a weighted minority cluster oversampling algorithm for within and between class imbalance; tested on 20 datasets with three classifiers.
Proposes a SMOTE scheme using K-means and intuitionistic fuzzy weights, paired with a quadratic surface SVM; tested on artificial and real sets with label noise.
Proposes a genetic-algorithm oversampler generating synthetic minority samples; compared with SMOTE and ADASYN using DNN, C4.5 and SVM.
Proposes GMO-AC: GMM-based minority generation with Mahalanobis outlier filtering and class overlap weighting; evaluated on synthetic and benchmark datasets against SMOTE and others.
Proposes three oversampling techniques (Improved SMOTE, Borderline-SMOTE plus IR, ADASYN plus IR) and compares them experimentally; evaluation appears to focus on class balance achieved.
Proposes fold-local class-conditional diffusion with anchored DDIM sampling and screening to generate minority samples; 25 microarray datasets.
Presents SMOTE followed by autoencoder noise reduction and a 1-D CNN as its method; ten imbalanced datasets.
Proposes GAN-AHR, choosing CGAN or Borderline-SMOTE per class by compactness and density; tested on NF-UNSW-NB15.

Chinese university journal with translated-style abstract, so probably not in English; no bracketed title. Content would otherwise be an include: kernel feature-space oversampling with pre-images for SVM.
Proposes SOAR: anomaly-score decile selection of minority seeds before oversampling, multiclass; 17 UCI datasets, ten classifiers.
Proposes NMOTe, a new minority oversampling algorithm for binary imbalanced data; performance shown on standard datasets.
Three-player adversarial game with a mixture of generators, discriminator and classifier for end-to-end oversampling; validated on imbalanced multiclass tabular sets.
Proposes CDE-SMOTE: SMOTE amount set by estimated target class distribution for cross-project defect prediction; 14 projects.
Proposes CDO, cluster-based oversampling with diversity optimisation of generated minority data; compared with SMOTE-based and diversity-based methods on synthetic and real sets.
Proposes WSEQ-GAN to augment imbalanced DNA sequence classes; compared with sampling and SMOTE using SVM, KNN and LSTM classifiers.
Proposes a new SMOTE-based sampling strategy with Relief-based feature selection and random forest; six benchmark and two application datasets, compared with SMOTE.
Framework for student outcome prediction develops a DCGAN-SMOTE balancer (conditional GAN with k-means-guided SMOTE interpolation); ablations on three datasets.
Proposes Kalman-SMOTE: SMOTE followed by Kalman filter removal of noisy raw and synthetic samples; validated on many datasets.
Proposes EVA-oversampling using Dempster-Shafer evidence to place synthetic minority points in high-confidence regions; beats SMOTE variants on F-measure and G-mean.
GAN-based oversampler that keeps only generated minority samples judged useful by k-NN; outperforms existing methods on F1. Korean journal, full-text language should be verified.
Intrusion detection framework with its own genetic-algorithm-inspired generator (one-point crossover, cosine similarity mutation) of synthetic minority instances; ablation on NF-UNSW-NB15.
Proposes GASMOTE: SMOTE followed by genetic selection, crossover and mutation of samples; 28 imbalanced datasets.
Proposes a class distribution alignment technique for imbalanced medical images but abstract does not say whether it generates synthetic examples, reweights or resamples; full text needed.
Proposes SMART-SMOTE with noise removal, feature selection, dissimilarity-based neighbor choice and Gaussian noise; tested on two datasets.
RS-DAAL puts a resampling phase inside a deep adversarial active learning loop and evaluates it; the resamplers tested are existing ones, so E1 is also defensible.
Proposes MNDO-NC: minority samples drawn from a multivariate normal for numeric features and neighbor voting for categorical ones; tested on 17 imbalanced sets.
Proposes FOS, a fuzzy information decomposition oversampler generating synthetic samples, used within a voting ensemble; evaluated on real Twitter spam data.
Visual analytics system that lets users steer existing under- and oversampling by instance hardness; no new generator, shown by usage scenario. Include is arguable as changed application of samplers.
Proposes ISMOTE, iterative generation near misclassified samples; compared with SMOTE and other oversamplers empirically.
Proposes SSPD, prototype-guided Deep SMOTE with importance-weighted interpolation for hyperspectral classes; tested on four benchmark scenes.
Proposes DAFL: drift test, dynamic SMOTE and adaptive client weighting for federated learning; evaluated on credit card fraud and UNSW data.
Proposes DEBOHID, a differential evolution based oversampler; tested on 44 highly imbalanced datasets against nine oversamplers with three classifiers.
ECG arrhythmia paper mainly about network architectures, but claims new oversampling and undersampling approaches and reports their recall gain; abstract does not say if samples are synthetic.
Improves SMOTE with a kNN graph and GCN feature-space generation followed by AE-GAN regeneration of samples; tested on five imbalanced datasets.
Proposes DCAES, a convolutional autoencoder with SMOTE generating minority attack samples, plus DBSCAN undersampling and Tomek links; tested on UNSW-NB15.
Proposes triangle SMOTE using three points, followed by iterative-partitioning filter, for Lamb wave damage detection; validated on a fatigue crack test.
Proposes GAVAE, combining VAE latent learning with adversarial training to generate minority-class traffic samples; evaluated on UNSW-NB15 and NSL-KDD.
IIoT intrusion model introducing boundary-prioritized FCM-SMOTE with fuzzy membership based seed selection and weights; evaluated on CICIDS2017.
Proposes WOOLASVM, online oversampling of the SVM boundary combined with dynamic cost weighting for imbalanced streams; abstract does not say whether oversampled points are synthetic.
Proposes nDeepSMOTEc, a DeepSMOTE modification for tabular data; 26 public datasets with SVM and neural networks against other oversamplers.
Proposes DBE ensemble: splits data into subsets and applies a modified adaptive semi-unsupervised weighted oversampling to each; 48 datasets.
Proposes Fed-DiTTab, a diffusion transformer that oversamples minority classes on each federated client; evaluated on public imbalanced datasets with ablation.
Proposes GDO: probabilistic anchor selection by density and distance, Gaussian generation of minority instances; tested on 40 KEEL and 10 UCI sets.
LoRA-adapted diffusion model generates rare-class images to augment training; evaluated on chest X-ray and surface defect classification with real held-out data.
Proposes ICOS, a correlation-based oversampling approach generating new synthetic instances for software defect data; experimental results reported.
Long-tailed recognition model whose own oversampling-based CutMix/Mixup hybrid (OHCM) generates tail-class images; four LT benchmarks.
Proposes DCIA prototype generation for multiclass imbalance: an instance reduction method producing prototypes for every class, not minority oversampling; include as I1-other is arguable.
Proposes NaNG-SMOTE: natural neighborhood graph for noise removal, subgraph cores, density-based weights and interpolation toward cores; beats 8 oversamplers.
Proposes a weight decision algorithm that sets how many samples to generate from each minority sample via edge detection gradients; evaluated on several imbalanced datasets.
Proposes ILMNN: metric-learned latent space, sample weighting and KL safeguard to guide oversampling; comparative experiments. Abstract is vague on how examples are generated.
Proposes SB-SVM-ensemble, SMOTE inside Bagging with SVM base learners, presented as a new method; tested on Chinese listed-company distress data.
Proposes augmentation-policy oversampling plus PGGAN to generate minority SAR images; tested on imbalanced MSTAR.
Appears to propose a regression and correlation coefficient based approach to create new sample patterns for imbalanced data, compared with SMOTE; abstract is unclear on generation.
Proposes NC_Link_MWMOTE, MWMOTE with NC_Link hierarchical clustering for synthesis; evaluated on six datasets with F1 and AUC.
Fraud detection method whose own module does kernel-guided adversarial generation of synthetic samples for extreme imbalance, inside federated reinforcement learning; tested on real fraud datasets.
Proposes K-means Triangular Synthesis generating samples by cluster density, combined with a unified pinball loss large margin classifier; tested on artificial and benchmark sets.
Proposes RAMGANH: range-based association rule undersampling combined with a modified tabular GAN oversampler; tested with SVM on standard datasets.
Proposes cCGen, a conditional classifier-generator to balance thermal comfort data; compared with SMOTE, ADASYN and cWGAN-GP at several imbalance ratios.
Claims embedding-level oversampling in a fused image-metadata space as key contribution for oral cancer detection; generation techniques may be existing ones, so E1 is also defensible.
